name: Victorian Olives
source:
Victorian Olives is a Kinetic Novel taking place in an alternate Victorian setting. We focus in on two young adults as they enjoy their time lazing in a garden and what the out come of their meetings have on their lives. Please follow me as we discover who Victoria and Oliver are and what it is they are searching for.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25640]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
